---
title: RL with slime
---

The slime integration uses SearcherKit as the custom agent rollout and reward
layer. slime owns SGLang rollout workers, Megatron training workers, Ray
placement, weight synchronization, and checkpoints.

## Prerequisites

Install slime according to [its manual](https://thudm.github.io/slime/get_started/quick_start.html). Install SearcherKit into the same training environment. The cluster must share access to model checkpoints, datasets, SearcherKit agent config, retrieval services, and output paths.

`src/searcherkit/config/training/train_slime.yaml` defines the SearcherKit agent
used during rollout. Select another config with `SEARCHERKIT_AGENT_CONFIG`.

## Integration hooks

| Responsibility | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Agent rollout and reward | `searcherkit.training.slime.rollout` |
| Fully asynchronous rollout | `searcherkit.training.slime.fully_async` |
| slime training entry points | `searcherkit.training.slime.train_dist` and `train_async` |
| IGPO advantage calculation | `searcherkit.training.slime.igpo` |

## Run training

The launch script contains cluster-specific defaults for an eight-GPU node:
four GPUs for Megatron actor training and four GPUs for SGLang rollout. Override
the model checkpoints, datasets, output directory, experiment name, and hardware
topology for your environment.

```bash
SEARCHERKIT_AGENT_CONFIG=src/searcherkit/config/training/train_slime.yaml \
HF_CHECKPOINT=/models/Qwen3-8B \
MEGATRON_CKPT=/models/Qwen3-8B_torch_dist \
PROMPT_DATA=/data/train.jsonl \
VALID_DATA=/data/validation.jsonl \
SAVE_ROOT=/checkpoints/searcherkit-slime \
TRIAL_NAME=qwen3-search-grpo \
ACTOR_NUM_NODES=1 \
ACTOR_NUM_GPUS_PER_NODE=4 \
ROLLOUT_NUM_GPUS=4 \
ROLLOUT_NUM_GPUS_PER_ENGINE=4 \
NUM_GPUS_PER_NODE=8 \
ROLLOUT_BATCH_SIZE=128 \
N_SAMPLES_PER_PROMPT=8 \
bash scripts/slime/train_grpo.sh
```

The training JSONL file must provide the `question`, `answer`, and `metadata`
fields expected by the launcher; the validation file must provide `question`
and `answer`. Update `agent.llm_client`, `agent.sources`,
`eval_agent.llm_client`, and `eval_agent.sources` in `train_slime.yaml` with the
model and retrieval service settings for your cluster. The `agent` and
`eval_agent` sections configure rollout and evaluation respectively. The
launcher uses fully asynchronous rollout by default. Set `SLIME_ASYNC_MODE=0`
for synchronous training.

Before allocating the training workers, prepend `DRY_RUN=1` to the same command
to inspect the resolved training module, rollout mode, batch sizes, config path,
and experiment name.
